metadata.notes: Manual intervention: agent's main.py went into an infinite loop while the agent was using the Bash tool to test it. Three concurrent Python subprocesses were stuck at 99.9% CPU each (~62-65min stuck), blocking Sonnet's Bash tool calls. Operator killed PIDs 232/227/240 inside the container at 13:16 CDT to unblock the agent. After the kill, agent recognized the timeout, fixed the suspected loop in its code, and completed voluntarily with 345/375 tests passing. Wall time of 5849s (97.5min) reflects ~62-65min of stuck-wait time — actual model work closer to ~30-35min. Tests still ran cleanly after the kill, so the run is included per the harness rules — but flag this when comparing wall-clock against other runs.
